events.name: San Francisco 49ers at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: — Everything seemed to indicate the San Francisco 49ers were in for a long night when they traveled south on a short week without Brock Purdy, Nick Bosa, George Kittle and their top three wide receivers to face the surging Los Angeles Rams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Short-handed 49ers stop Rams on downs in overtime, preserving a 26-23 victory

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at Cleveland Browns
Las Vegas Raiders at Indianapolis Colts

headlines.description: — Jonathan Taylor keeps proving he's one of the league’s top running backs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jonathan Taylor runs for 3 touchdowns and Daniel Jones throws for 2 as Colts rout Raiders 40-6

events.name: New York Giants at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: — Spencer Rattler was so fired up by the sight of Rashid Shaheed hauling in his deep throw down the right sideline that the second-year quarterback started sprinting the length of the field to join the celebration.
headlines.shortLinkText: Saints QB Spencer Rattler and coach Kellen Moore get 1st win over mistake-prone Giants, 26-14

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at New York Jets

headlines.description: — Dak Prescott had a makeshift offensive line in front of him against a team desperate for its first win and still marched the Dallas Cowboys up and down the field.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cowboys dominate Jets 37-22 behind Prescott's 4 TD passes, two 90-yard scoring drives

events.name: Denver Broncos at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: — Sean Payton had a game ball in hand and stories to tell after he passed his mentor and friend Bill Parcells on the NFL career wins list. The pair of Super Bowl champion coaches caught up recently and shot the breeze, talking about playing tough road...
headlines.shortLinkText: Broncos rally from 14-point deficit to hand Eagles their first loss of the season, 21-17

events.name: Miami Dolphins at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: — Panthers coach Dave Canales preached to his players this past week about not allowing things to spiral out of control following a 29-point road loss to...
headlines.shortLinkText: Bryce Young, Rico Dowdle help Panthers rally from 17 points down to beat Dolphins 27-24

events.name: Houston Texans at Baltimore Ravens

headlines.description: — In three previous matchups with Baltimore, C.J. Stroud had failed to lead Houston to an offensive touchdown, so when the Texans took the ball 67 yards in 10 plays for a TD on the game's first possession, that felt like a breakthrough in itself.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stroud throws for 4 touchdowns as the Texans blow out the battered Ravens 44-10

events.name: Tennessee Titans at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: — Coach Brian Callahan has been adamant over the past few weeks that his Tennessee Titans could be a good team if the football started bouncing their way.
headlines.shortLinkText: Titans snap 10-game skid with improbable comeback to beat Cardinals 22-21

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: — Lavonte David slid toward the middle of the field in anticipation as Buccaneers teammate Antoine Winfield Jr. pressured Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold.
headlines.shortLinkText: David's pick sets up winning FG as Bucs beat Seahawks 38-35 in duel between Mayfield and Darnold

events.name: Detroit Lions at Cincinnati Bengals

headlines.description: — David Montgomery had to wait nearly 10 years to play another football game in his hometown.
headlines.shortLinkText: David Montgomery dominates in his hometown as Lions beat Bengals 37-24

events.name: Washington Commanders at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: — Playing for the first time as a pro not far from his hometown, Jayden Daniels started slowly in his return after missing two games with an injured...
headlines.shortLinkText: Commanders rally from 10-0 deficit with 27 straight points to beat Chargers 27-10

events.name: New England Patriots at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: — Receiver Stefon Diggs is quite comfortable putting on a show in Buffalo. The big difference on Sunday night was doing so for the Bills’ division rival New England Patriots.
headlines.shortLinkText: Drake Maye leads Patriots to 23-20 win over Bills, leaving NFL without an unbeaten team

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: — Trevor Lawrence tripped and fell to the ground, stumbled trying to get up, finally got back on his feet and then scrambled for a 1-yard touchdown with 23 seconds remaining — turning a...
headlines.shortLinkText: Trevor Lawrence's wild run lifts the Jaguars to a 31-28 win over Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at New York Giants

headlines.description: — Cam Skattebo and Jaxson Dart sat next to each other on the flight home from New Orleans and lamented the turnovers they committed that caused the New York Giants to lose a game they...
headlines.shortLinkText: Cam Skattebo runs for 3 TDs and Jaxson Dart shines as the Giants beat the Eagles 34-17

events.name: Denver Broncos at New York Jets

headlines.description: — It seemed every time Patrick Surtain II looked, his Denver Broncos teammates were sacking Justin Fields.
headlines.shortLinkText: Broncos get 9 sacks and beat the winless Jets in ugly 13-11 victory in London

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at Indianapolis Colts

headlines.description: — It was Jonathan Taylor running the ball and Daniel Jones making crucial plays at big moments.
headlines.shortLinkText: Daniel Jones throws for 2 touchdowns as the Colts rally past the Cardinals for a 31-27 win

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: — Jim Harbaugh will never forget the sequence.
headlines.shortLinkText: Justin Herbert rallies the Chargers in the final minute for a 29-27 win over the Dolphins

events.name: New England Patriots at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: — Louisiana native Kayshon Boutte bought 40 tickets for New England's visit to New Orleans and the former LSU receiver got his money's worth.
headlines.shortLinkText: Maye throws 3 TD passes and the Patriots hold on to beat the Saints 25-19

events.name: Cleveland Browns at Pittsburgh Steelers

headlines.description: — Aaron Rodgers knows the Pittsburgh Steelers are hardly a finished product five games into the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Aaron Rodgers throws for 2 TDs as Steelers continue home dominance of Browns in 23-9 win

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: — Rico Dowdle warned his former Dallas Cowboys teammates last week they'd better get ready and buckle up.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dowdle has 239 yards from scrimmage vs. former team as Panthers beat Cowboys on FG as time expires

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: — Having thrown a combined six interceptions in his last two starts in Jacksonville, Sam Darnold refused to get greedy this time around.
headlines.shortLinkText: Darnold, Smith-Njigba and defense carry Seahawks to 20-12 victory at Jaguars

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Baltimore Ravens

headlines.description: — The first half was the stuff of nightmares for the Los Angeles Rams: penalties, poor kicking, a turnover and even an injury to star receiver Puka Nacua.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rams stuff the Lamar Jackson-less Ravens 17-3, dropping Baltimore to 1-5

events.name: Tennessee Titans at Las Vegas Raiders

headlines.description: — It was Devin White and Maxx Crosby and Jonah Laulu and seemingly every defender wearing Raiders silver and black.
headlines.shortLinkText: The Raiders end a 4-game skid by dominating on defense to beat the Titans 20-10

events.name: Cincinnati Bengals at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: — This time, the Green Bay Packers built a double-digit lead and finished the job.
headlines.shortLinkText: Packers overcome Flacco's comeback attempt and beat the Bengals 27-18

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: — Baker Mayfield shrugged off the “MVP!” chants the way he shook away from tacklers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Baker Mayfield tosses 2 touchdown passes and the Buccaneers beat the 49ers 30-19

events.name: Detroit Lions at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: — Patrick Mahomes and the Kansas City Chiefs knew they were going to have a fight on their hands when the Detroit Lions, riding a four-game winning streak and a whole bunch of momentum, rolled into Arrowhead Stadium on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mahomes leads the Chiefs to a 30-17 victory over Lions, and a fistfight erupts at the finish

events.name: Buffalo Bills at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: — Big plays from Bijan Robinson and Drake London and mistake-free leadership from Michael Penix Jr. made the Atlanta Falcons look like a playoff contender.
headlines.shortLinkText: Falcons ride Robinson's 170 rushing yards, including 81-yard TD, to 24-14 win over Allen and Bills

events.name: Chicago Bears at Washington Commanders
Pittsburgh Steelers at Cincinnati Bengals

headlines.description: — Mike Tomlin wondered this week why the Cleveland Browns traded Joe Flacco to their AFC North rival, the Cincinnati Bengals.
headlines.shortLinkText: Flacco rallies Bengals past Rodgers and Steelers 33-31 in battle of 40-year-old QBs

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: — Matthew Stafford won't get knighted for his record-setting performance at Wembley Stadium, but he wondered if he still gets a prize.
headlines.shortLinkText: Matthew Stafford throws 5 TD passes as Rams rout Jaguars 35-7 at rainy Wembley

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: — As much as Dennis Allen downplayed going against his former team, his players weren't buying it. This one had to mean a little more.
headlines.shortLinkText: Allen's defense dominates against former team as Bears beat Saints 26-14 for 4th straight win

events.name: Miami Dolphins at Cleveland Browns

headlines.description: — Grant Delpit said leading up to Cleveland's game against Miami that he forgot what it was like to be a part of a win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Quinshon Judkins scores 3 touchdowns as Browns roll to 31-6 victory over Dolphins

events.name: New England Patriots at Tennessee Titans

headlines.description: — Mike Vrabel greeted his New England Patriots with a celebratory hug just as he did with the Tennessee Titans not far away in Nissan Stadium and not too long ago.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patriots rout the Titans 31-13 in coach Mike Vrabel's return to Tennessee

events.name: Las Vegas Raiders at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: — The Kansas City Chiefs so thoroughly dominated the Las Vegas Raiders on Sunday that they probably didn't need Rashee Rice, who had come back from a torn ACL and a six-game suspension to give them yet another dynamic weapon.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patrick Mahomes leads Chiefs to 31-0 rout of Raiders as Rashee Rice returns with 2 TDs

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at Minnesota Vikings

headlines.description: — Though many of the elements that made the Philadelphia Eagles champions last season had been missing during this unsettling start, their confidence in themselves never lacked.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jalen Hurts jump-starts the Eagles by passing for 326 yards and 3 TDs in a 28-22 win vs. Vikings

events.name: Carolina Panthers at New York Jets

headlines.description: — The Carolina Panthers have a three-game winning streak for the first time with Bryce Young as their starting quarterback.
headlines.shortLinkText: Panthers beat Jets 13-6 for third straight win, but Bryce Young leaves with injured ankle

events.name: New York Giants at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: — Once the bungling, bumbling Denver Broncos finally got going, they couldn't be stopped.
headlines.shortLinkText: Broncos stun Giants 33-32 with last-second field goal in historic comeback

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: — The Indianapolis Colts finally got a win in Los Angeles, where coach Shane Steichen paid his dues before now directing the NFL's best scoring offense.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jonathan Taylor scores 3 touchdowns and Colts beat Chargers 38-24 for NFL-leading 6th victory

events.name: Washington Commanders at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: — CeeDee Lamb ran sideways, arms in the air with the ball in one hand while finishing off a 74-yard touchdown catch with new sidekick George Pickens backpedaling into the end zone at the same time from just a few yards away.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lamb has a 74-yard TD catch and Bland gets a pick-6 as Cowboys beat Commanders 44-22

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: — The majority of this road trip didn't go well for the Green Bay Packers, who waited on a tarmac several hours because of travel delays on Saturday before falling into a 10-point hole in the first half on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Jacobs runs for 2 TDs, Micah Parsons has 3 sacks as Packers rally past Cardinals 27-23

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: — For all the stars the San Francisco 49ers might have been missing, they still had Christian McCaffrey.
headlines.shortLinkText: Christian McCaffrey's 200-yard game from scrimmage powers 49ers past Falcons 20-10

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: — Jahmyr Gibbs was offered oxygen on the bench after a 78-yard run.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gibbs has career-high 218 yards of offense and 2 TDs, helping Lions bounce back and beat Bucs 24-9

events.name: Houston Texans at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: — Jaxon Smith-Njigba called it spontaneous. Sam Darnold was simply surprised.
headlines.shortLinkText: Smith-Njigba, defense show out again for Seahawks in 27-19 win against Texans

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: — Four days after a humbling loss, the Los Angeles Chargers bounced back in a big way.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chargers dominate Vikings 37-10 as Justin Herbert throws for 3 TDs

events.name: Miami Dolphins at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: — Tua Tagovailoa may have to consider making a helmet visor more than a one-time addition to his uniform.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tua Tagovailoa throws 4 TD passes as Dolphins overwhelm Falcons 34-10 to end 3-game losing streak

events.name: New York Jets at Cincinnati Bengals

headlines.description: — The winless start for the New York Jets took a toll on Justin Fields. At one point in the runup to Sunday's game in Cincinnati, he found himself laying down in his closet and crying.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hall and Fields help the Jets edge the Bengals 39-38 for their 1st win of the season

events.name: Cleveland Browns at New England Patriots

headlines.description: — New England Patriots coach Mike Vrabel wanted to add energy in Gillette Stadium after watching his team lose two of its first three games at home to open the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Drake Maye throws 3 TDs as Patriots overcome Myles Garrett's 5-sack game in 32-13 win over Browns

events.name: New York Giants at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: — Saquon Barkley burst free for a 65-yard touchdown on his first carry and topped 100 yards rushing for the first time this season before he left with a groin injury, the kind of setback that...
headlines.shortLinkText: Saquon Barkley breaks out with 150 yards before hurting groin as Eagles pound Giants 38-20

events.name: Buffalo Bills at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: — A little rest proved just what Josh Allen and the Buffalo Bills needed.
headlines.shortLinkText: James Cook runs for 216 yards and 2 TDs, Allen accounts for 3 TDs as Bills rout Panthers 40-9

events.name: Chicago Bears at Baltimore Ravens

headlines.description: — In what they hope will be their final game before Lamar Jackson returns, the Baltimore Ravens finally looked pretty good without him.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tyler Huntley leads Ravens past Bears 30-16, Derrick Henry scores 2 TDs for Baltimore

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at Houston Texans

headlines.description: — With star receiver Nico Collins out Sunday against San Francisco, the Houston Texans needed someone to step up to make up for his absence.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stroud has season-high 318 yards passing with two TDs to lead the Texans over the 49ers 26-15

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: — Anthony Nelson will have to settle for watching replays of one of the best plays of his seven-year NFL career — because he couldn't really recall how it all happened in real time.
headlines.shortLinkText: Anthony Nelson and the Buccaneers' defense shine in a 23-3 victory over the struggling Saints

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: — A trio of rookies came up big in the Denver Broncos' 44-24 rout of the Dallas Cowboys on Sunday for their fifth consecutive victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bo Nix and rookies lead Broncos to 44-24 victory over Cowboys, extending home win streak to 9

events.name: Tennessee Titans at Indianapolis Colts

headlines.description: — Jonathan Taylor embraced having a lighter workload and a shorter day Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jonathan Taylor scores 3 TDs as Colts pound Titans 38-14 and move to NFL-best 7-1

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Pittsburgh Steelers

headlines.description: — Jordan Love spent three years absorbing what he could from Aaron Rodgers. Footwork. Cadence. Throwing motion. Film study. The list of things Love gleaned from his mentor goes on and on, every last item invaluable in Love's development.
headlines.shortLinkText: Aaron Rodgers and the Steelers fall short in QB's reunion with Packers as Love leads 35-25 win

events.name: Washington Commanders at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: — Chiefs coach Andy Reid called the first half of Monday night's game against Washington downright weird, full of turnovers and failed fourth-down conversions and so much lousy execution by both teams that he was left scratching his head.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mahomes, Hunt lead Chiefs to dominant 28-7 win over Commanders, their 9th straight in the series

events.name: Baltimore Ravens at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: — Lamar Jackson returned for the Baltimore Ravens, and so did the chants of “M-V-P!” — on the road.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lamar Jackson torches Miami with 4 TD passes in return from injury and Ravens rout Dolphins 28-6
